question: What is the performance reported for the best models in the VLSP 2018 and VLSP 2019 challenges?
title: VAIS ASR: Building a conversational speech recognition system using language model combination
answer_short: 4.85% WER on VLSP 2018 and 15.09% WER on VLSP 2019
answer_rationale: The retrieved document explicitly states that the system achieved 4.85% WER on VLSP 2018 and 15.09% WER on VLSP 2019 datasets, as evaluated on the VLSP 2019 ASR challenge.
